application: CardDemo is a comprehensive mainframe-based credit card management application developed as an AWS Mainframe Modernization reference and demonstration system. The application provides end-to-end credit card account lifecycle management, encompassing customer account administration, transaction processing, authorization handling, billing, and reporting. It operates across both online interactive workflows powered by CICS and batch processing pipelines, supporting daily operations such as transaction posting, interest calculation, statement generation, and end-of-day processing. The system maintains a rich set of data stores including VSAM files for accounts, customers, cards, transactions, and cross-reference data, with additional support for IMS hierarchical databases and DB2 relational tables for specialized modules such as authorization processing and transaction type management. Security and user access management are built into the application through dedicated user security files and RACF integration. Supporting infrastructure includes file initialization and setup routines, backup and recovery mechanisms, data extraction and reporting jobs, and MQ-based messaging integration for real-time authorization workflows. The application also includes utility functions for date validation, timing control, and file management, making it a full-featured demonstration of traditional mainframe application architecture patterns applied to the credit card processing domain.
